description_en: Enables the LogShipper feature of Log Service for a resource group
description_zh: 开通资源组SLS日志投递功能
kebab_example: aliyun eas create-resource-log --cluster-id cn-shanghai --resource-id eas-r-asdasdasd0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateResourceLog

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the resource group belongs
parameters.help_zh: 资源组所在的地域ID。例如华东2（上海）为cn-shanghai
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. For more information about how to query the ID of a resource group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源组的ID。如何查询资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The Logstore of Log Service. For more information about how to query a Logstore, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426970.html
parameters.help_zh: SLS日志库，如何查询日志库，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426970.html
parameters.name: log_store

parameters.help_en: The Log Service project that is associated with the resource group. For more information about how to query the project, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/74955.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源组对应的SLS日志管理项目。如何查询项目，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/74955.html
parameters.name: project_name
